description: GST F5 return and payment: one month after the end of the accounting period
CPF contributions for the month, due on its last day: paid by the 14th of the next month, or the next working day, before enforcement and late-payment interest
The calendar year's employment income submitted to IRAS under the Auto-Inclusion Scheme: by 1 March
Estimated chargeable income: within 3 months from the end of the financial year, unless waived (revenue of $5 million or below and ECI nil)
Form C-S, C-S (Lite) or C for the year of assessment after the year the financial year ends in: by 30 November
The annual return to ACRA: within seven months after the financial year end
The annual return to ACRA with an overseas branch register: within eight months after the financial year end
The annual general meeting: within six months after the financial year end
The financial statements sent to all members within five months after the financial year end, so no AGM is held
Apply for GST registration after a calendar year above the threshold: by 30 January of the next year
Registered for GST after a calendar year above the threshold: from 1 March of the next year
Apply for GST registration after a forecast above the threshold: within 30 days after the date of the forecast
Registered for GST after a forecast above the threshold made on or after 1 Jul 2025: 2 months from the date of the forecast
